bio: Sharonda is an epidemiologist with expertise in reproductive and environmental health. She has been an APHA member for 8 years and has served in elected/appointed leadership roles within APHA for 5+ years. She currently serves as Co-Chair of the APHA Epidemiology Section Mentoring Committee, where she co-leads mentoring webinars and virtual networking activities. She seeks an APHA membership to continue facilitating the exchange of resources among APHA early career professionals.
